canonical_project: Almadar Aljadid data centre (Benghazi, root-server site)
notes: GACI (General Authority for Communications and Informatics) officially launched Libya's root servers (Oct 2025) operating through data centres of Almadar Aljadid in Tripoli and Benghazi, under the National Telecommunications and Informatics Strategy 2023-2027; confirms operational Almadar DC in Benghazi (B-grade trade press reporting of official GACI announcement; A-grade GACI/LANA primary source pending).
